summary: Decision: keep v1.2 as the strongest tested candidate; v1.4 does not replace it. Both reviewers preferred v1.2 overall. The task-first revision answered the brief more directly but repeated product lists and price lines. See AD_COPY_ITERATION_DECISION.md for both rounds and what to keep.
limitations: Reviewer scores are unstable: the same five generic sets rose from 55.7 to 69.4 when re-rated in this batch without changing the copy; the same five v1.2 sets rose from 76.0 to 80.9. The sole fresh brief was essentially tied (generic 75, v1.2 76, v1.4 77). Scores are editorial signals, not conversion evidence. The v1.4 phrase 'six childproofing items' also needs correction because exact piece count is unverified. No further tuning was performed in this run.
